summary: Frontend-only verification of WalletGate ETH fee refactor. /play renders 3-step gate with correct new 'Entry Fee' text mentioning 90% of ETH balance on Robinhood Chain. No Blockscout network requests, no BYPASS FEE button, no TEST-USDC, no ERC-20 references, no console/page errors. Regression routes (/, /leaderboard, /how-to-play, /roadmap, /nft/36) render without JS crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletGate.jsx line 132: `const paid = named ? feePaid : feePaid;` is a tautology (both branches identical). Likely a leftover — safe to simplify to `const paid = feePaid;`.

fee_paid_<address> is stored only in localStorage — no server-side verification of the on-chain transfer. A user can bypass the fee by writing the localStorage key manually. Consider verifying the tx hash server-side (POST /api/fee/verify with hash, check receipt on Robinhood RPC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The WalletGate ETH fee flow is validated on the static/no-wallet path. Actual on-chain payment via wagmi useSendTransaction cannot be automated without an injected wallet. All original acceptance criteria (new copy present, Blockscout gone, BYPASS gone, no console crashes, gated routes work) verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification only; previous bug (Blockscout Cloudflare-block) confirmed removed.
